text:
alex: FYI sample-app CI started failing after the typegen bump landed on main.
maria: ugh, noticed a regen diff earlier. which tests are failing? @kevin any idea?
alex: unit + e2e. failing on build step with TS errors about exported interfaces not matching.
kevin: can you paste the compiler output?
alex: ```
src/sdk/client.ts:45:13 - error TS2322: Type '{ id: string; kind: string; }' is not assignable to type 'ModelThing'.
  Object literal may only specify known properties, and 'kind' does not exist in type 'ModelThing'.
```
sam: that looks like a shape change from typegen. I think the new generator dropped the discriminant field name.
maria: the PR was #4319 — the generator now prefers `type` over `kind` for unions (internal rename). I missed that in the changelog.
julia: so SDK parity is broken because the sample app depends on `kind`. We need a mitigation: publish a patch or revert the typegen change?
kevin: quick triage: if we can teach typegen to emit the old alias with a deprecation comment, we can patch without rolling back.
alex: sample-app release is blocked; npm publish step fails in the release job since `@redwood/sdk` tests fail.
devex-bot: CI: circleci/sample-app#789 failed — publishing step aborted (link: https://ci.example/789) :x:
maria: semver-wise, this should've been a breaking change (major) but the PR was merged with a minor bump. That's the root cause — changelog & semver mismatch.
sam: action items:
- revert the generator change in a hotfix PR (assign @kevin)
- add a validation in the CI regen check to flag interface renames (assign @maria)
- publish a patch SDK with the old `kind` alias (assign @julia)
kevin: started a branch `hotfix/typegen-kind-alias` and opened draft PR #4323, adding compatibility typedef and a test.
julia: I'll prepare a patch release once CI passes. need an approval for emergency publish in npm org.
maria: I'll follow up on the changelog automation — looks like our regen-diff bot didn't flag this as breaking. filing issue to augment the linter.
alex: thanks — can we also add a small sample-app smoke test that imports the SDK types and compiles? Caught earlier would save time.
sam: yes, adding a tiny `tsc` check to sample-app job makes sense.
kevin: PR #4323 pushed; CI currently running. ping me if anything blocks the publish.
julia: once green I'll run `npm version patch` and publish with `--tag latest` and notify customers.
alex: :thumbsup: keep updates here. anyone who wants to jump on quick pairing to reduce blast radius ping me.
maria: note for postmortem: clarify semver rules for typegen, and add a checklist for regen PRs (changelog, hand-verify unions)
devex-bot: reminder: deploy freeze until hotfix is resolved (automated):calendar:
